pillar: P1 功能三步驟（三步驟）
hook_zh: 長 PDF 先抓重點？先看上限。
caption_zh:
【AI 虛擬角色】本影片由 AI 生成的虛擬角色「步驟」說明，畫面中的角色為 AI 生成，並非真人；螢幕錄影由工作室真人操作。資料日期：{YYYY/MM/DD}。
錄製條件：{工具}｜{版本}｜{方案}｜{YYYY/MM/DD}　由工作室真人操作錄製
資料來源：{說明中心頁面名稱}（{YYYY/MM/DD}）{網址}
長 PDF 先抓重點，3 步驟：
1. 看上限：檔案格式、大小、頁數，各工具與方案不同
2. 上傳範例檔（工作室自製，內容虛構）；真正的文件上傳前先確認沒有個資
3. 請它列出重點，再回原文對照日期和數字
示範輸出，不代表每次相同。上限可能已變動，請以官方頁面為準。
本頻道與影片中提到的工具廠商無隸屬或合作關係。
#AI工具 #PDF #提示詞
caption_gloss_en:
[AI virtual character] This video is explained by the AI-generated virtual character "Buzhou"; the character on screen is AI-generated and is not a real person; the screen recording is operated by a real person at the studio. Data date: {date}.
Recording conditions: {tool} | {version} | {plan} | {date}  operated and recorded by a real person at the studio
Sources: {help-centre page name} ({date}) {URL}
Pulling key points from a long PDF, 3 steps:
1. Check the limits: file format, size, pages; they differ by tool and plan
2. Upload the sample file (made by the studio, content fictional); with a real document, first make sure it holds no personal data
3. Ask it to list the key points, then compare the dates and numbers with the original
Demonstration output; it is not the same every time. Limits may have changed; go by the official page.
This channel has no affiliation or partnership with the tool vendors mentioned in the video.
#AI工具 #PDF #提示詞
on_screen_label_zh: AI 生成｜虛擬角色（每一影格都有；後製加上，不由生成工具繪製）。另有「錄製條件」「資料來源」標籤，內容見行事曆

sources.claim: The vendor's own help-centre article states the file upload limits quoted in scene 4 (「{上限}」) for the plan used, with its units; the operator pastes the exact line, URL and date seen. If the page does not list limits per plan, soften scene 4 and the line 「上限依工具與方案而不同」 to 「上限以官方頁面為準」.
Recording conditions on the strip are read from the app's own about or account screen at recording time (frame grab).

NO FACTUAL CLAIM about any vendor: every date and number in the shown output is checked against the fictional sample PDF (sample kit item B, digits listed in calendar-30d.md section 7.7); steps 2 and 3 are the studio's own method.

media.description: HUMAN SCREEN RECORDING (no generation tool): S2_rec_raw_01.mp4, Takes 1 to 4 of calendar-30d.md section 5 M2 (the vendor limits page, upload the fictional sample PDF 範例會議紀錄.pdf, ask for three key points, compare dates and numbers), no audio, untouched. Plus the help-page screenshot S2_limits_01.png.
media.shot_prompt: NO GENERATION PROMPT: this is a human screen recording made by the studio's operator, not an AI-generated video. Recording plan: calendar-30d.md section 5, M2 'Recording plan'. Log it in assets/provenance.csv as a human-made asset (tool: the recorder and its version; prompt: 'none, screen recording by the operator').

media.description: Stills of the openly-AI character for the corner picture-in-picture, from the approved photoreal golden set: E04, E06, E01, E07 and R06 right (pack pipeline/image-pack/buzhou-photoreal.md sections 4.1 and 4.4). STILL IMAGES ONLY, or a slow pan or zoom of a still (decision D6, DECISIONS.md 2026-10-12; photoreal addendum 7, risk 8 is read together with D6): no blinking, lip-sync, morphing, dissolve between two face stills or frame interpolation; expression changes are hard cuts between separate approved stills at scene boundaries; no synthetic voice. Square crops are made on copies and logged with their parent file; never flipped. Alt text for any still posted alone: AI 生成的虛擬角色步驟，示意圖，非真人。
media.shot_prompt: PREFER REUSE of the approved golden-set files (R06_pr_pip_right_v1, R03_pr_E01_v1, E04, E06, E07 as listed); do not generate new images for this Short. If a file is missing or not approved, generate it with its own prompt in pipeline/image-pack/buzhou-photoreal.md (section 4.1 for E01 to E10, section 4.4 for R06); the prompt is not repeated here so the pack stays the single source of truth. Never upload a photograph of any real person. No provider adapter is called by this file; generation is manual until the operator supplies an image-API key (pipeline adapters stay inert).

media.description: EDITED EXPORT S2_export_v1.mp4, 1080 x 1920, under 60 s, captions only, no voice, no music. Layers (never made by an image model) from the layout kit in calendar-30d.md section 7.1, drawn by Claude as vector SVG and rendered to PNG, or typeset by the operator in an editor; the operator and the wife approve every layer before use: badge 「AI 生成｜虛擬角色」 on every frame, 錄製條件 strip, 資料來源 label, date stamp, step numerals, outline callouts, PiP frame, burned-in captions from the M2 scene table. The wife reads every on-screen character.
